title: Meal photo log — 7 days
hypothesis: Photographing meals for 7 days will increase awareness of meal timing and protein-containing meals without requiring calorie obsession.

intervention.summary: Before eating main meals, take a simple photo and log time + whether the meal included a protein-containing food.
steps: Mark protein-containing food present: yes/no (your definition; be consistent).
Weekly: review patterns with steward or AI using redacted context only.

expected_effect.note: Goal is visibility and accountability, not weight targets unless set with a clinician.

stop_conditions: Clinician or therapist advises against food photography/tracking
contraindications: Active eating disorder treatment where food logging is restricted
Clinician-prescribed medical diet that forbids self-experiments

safety.emergency_route: For medical emergencies call local emergency services.
